candidate_hunks.annotation: The AI-coauthored server initializer applies merged policy before the Endpoint Security client is started in main.swift. The candidate digest covers the full 40-file commit patch; the displayed hunks are its causal slice.
candidate_hunks.code:
init(interactor: FilterInteractor, adapter: ESInboundAdapter) {
        self.interactor = interactor
        self.adapter = adapter
        self.database = Database(directory: dataDirectory)

        userRules = database.loadUserRules()
        managedRules = ManagedPolicyLoader.load()
        userAllowlist = database.loadUserAllowlist()
        managedAllowlist = ManagedAllowlistLoader.load()
        xprotectEntries = enumerateXProtectEntries()
        NSLog("XPCServer: Discovered %d XProtect allowlist entry/entries", xprotectEntries.count)

        super.init()

        applyPolicyToFilter()
        applyAllowlistToFilter()
    }

candidate_hunks.annotation: Because client is still nil, the early policy call returns before updating the interactor with managed and user rules.
The candidate constructs XPCServer before adapter.start, so the initializer's policy call runs too early.

comparison_hunks.annotation: The fix removes policy application before startup and reapplies the full policy immediately after the Endpoint Security client starts.

auth_access.definition: Missing, bypassed, or confused authentication, authorization, identity, ownership, tenant, or privilege boundaries.
auth_access.label: Authentication & access control

injection.definition: Untrusted data reaches command, shell, template, script, query, spreadsheet, HTML, or similar execution contexts without safe encoding or isolation.
injection.label: Injection & unsafe execution

other_ambiguous.definition: The canonical mechanism fields do not expose enough stable public detail for a more specific cause category.
other_ambiguous.label: Other / insufficient public mechanism detail

path_link.definition: Unsafe path construction, filesystem scope checks, archive extraction, local file access, or symbolic-link handling.
path_link.label: Path & link handling

resource_abuse.definition: Unbounded input, computation, memory, storage, retry, rate, or loop behavior enables denial of service or disproportionate resource use.
resource_abuse.label: Resource abuse & availability

ssrf_network.definition: Unsafe URL parsing, redirects, proxying, credential forwarding, or destination checks allow unintended network access or trust-boundary crossing.
ssrf_network.label: SSRF & network boundaries

validation_fail_open.definition: A security validator, denylist, signature, or schema check is incomplete, incorrectly ordered, or allows processing after validation cannot be established.
validation_fail_open.label: Validation & fail-open logic
